title: Playwright generation
whenNotToUse: Highly flaky visual animations as first target.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Generate Playwright test for {{journey}}.

CONTEXT:
App URL pattern: {{url}}.

INPUT:
Steps: {{steps}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- Prefer role/text selectors
- Assert outcomes not implementation
- Avoid sleeps

OUTPUT:
Test code + run command

ACCEPTANCE:
Fails if journey breaks.

VERIFICATION:
Run locally.
improvedPrompt: E2E login→add-to-cart→checkout success; use getByRole; no networkidle sleeps.
